messages:
jess: Heads-up—UX review for playground schema editor at 3pm today. Please bring notes on function-def flow and run history.
omar: ack. will focus on tool-calling modal and accessibility states.
lina: quick thought: the schema editor toolbar feels cramped when you have function defs + examples. Could we move 'add example' into a collapsible panel?
omar: +1. Also keyboard nav for the function list is broken in mac safari.
jess: noted. @lina can you mock a compact toolbar? A11y: focus order should be linear for screen reader users.
marco: for run history, can we add an inline "replay" action not just open run detail? saves 2 clicks.
sam: replay button is fine but we need rate limit guard—users might spam replays. Maybe disable for 5s with tooltip.
ux-bot: accessibility checklist: contrast ratio for gray labels < 3:1. Flagged 2 instances in schema editor.
lina: ugh, I saw that. I'll update the label color and adjust token counters.
omar: copy nit — 'Define functions' header reads like an imperative. Maybe change to 'Function definitions' to match other panels.
jess: yes prefer noun forms across console. Also suggest 'Run history' -> 'Execution history' ?
marco: 'Execution history' sounds heavier. 'Recent runs' might be friendlier.
sam: Agree 'Recent runs' is clearer for non-technical users.
jess: decision: 'Function definitions' + 'Recent runs'. Lina can update mocks. Omar, please file a safari bug with repro steps.
omar: filing now: 1752001283 - attached steps & console logs.
lina: mock v2 uploaded to Figma: https://figma.com/file/xyz - focused on collapsible examples + keyboard nav.
jess: perfect. Next steps: lina -> update colors & copy; omar -> bug; sam -> add replay debounce; marco -> small UX doc on run affordances. Sync 3pm.
marco: adding a tiny diagram to doc about inline replay vs open details.
